subject: eng
title: Grammar 2A Ch 5: Where & How, Transport & Prepositions

questions.q: I live in Causeway Bay. It is ___ Hong Kong Island.
questions.explain: 島嶼（Hong Kong Island, Lantau Island, Lamma Island, Cheung Chau）前面用介詞 on。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: I live in Causeway Bay. It is ___ Hong Kong Island.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 5: Where & How, Transport & Prepositions

questions.q: Mr Smith lives ___ Tuen Mun. It is in the New Territories.
questions.explain: 地區名稱（如 Tuen Mun, Sha Tin, Kwun Tong, Kowloon）前面用介詞 in。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Mr Smith lives ___ Tuen Mun. It is in the New Territories.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 5: Where & How, Transport & Prepositions

questions.q: ___ do you come to school? I come to school by school bus.
questions.explain: 詢問上學的交通方式（by school bus）用疑問詞 How。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: ___ do you come to school? I come to school by school bus.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 5: Where & How, Transport & Prepositions

questions.q: Jerry lives near his school. He comes to school ___ foot.
questions.explain: 步行上學固定用 on foot（不可說 by foot）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Jerry lives near his school. He comes to school ___ foot.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 5: Where & How, Transport & Prepositions

questions.q: Meg comes to school ___ MTR every morning.
questions.explain: 乘搭交通工具（by bus / by car / by MTR / by ferry / by tram）用介詞 by，中間不加 the。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Meg comes to school ___ MTR every morning.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 5: Where & How, Transport & Prepositions

questions.q: '___ here, Rocky!' says Bob to his dog.
questions.explain: 叫對方朝向說話者走過來用 Come here（Go 表示離開說話者去別處）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: '___ here, Rocky!' says Bob to his dog.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 5: Where & How, Transport & Prepositions

questions.q: Fill in the preposition: My aunt lives ___ Lantau Island.
questions.explain: Lantau Island 是島嶼，介詞用 on。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Fill in the preposition: My aunt lives ___ Lantau Island.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 5: Where & How, Transport & Prepositions

questions.q: 'How you come to school?' is a grammatically correct question.
questions.explain: 一般現在時疑問句不能漏掉助動詞 do，應為：How do you come to school?
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: 'How you come to school?' is a grammatically correct question.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 5: Where & How, Transport & Prepositions
